title: Seagrove "Beach Please" 327 Eastern Lake Road Carriage House
h1: Seagrove "Beach Please" 327 Eastern Lake Road Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Minutes from the beach- Parking lot is available at Eastern Lake Beach Access- Professionally decorated- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover convenience and casual elegance at Beach Please Carriage House! This 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom Seagrove Beach retreat accommodates up to 4 guests. Situated a short walk from beach access, guests will love spending each day soaking up rays on the sugar-soft sand beaches, paddling across the glistening Gulf waters, or exploring the local shops and restaurants of this illustrious beach town.Head up the exterior staircase to enter this elegant single-level home. As guests step inside, pale walls and deep hardwood floors throughout the combined living and kitchen space set the scene for a peaceful and relaxing getaway. The kitchen’s sparkling countertops and high-end appliances entice guests to spend sunlit mornings cooking eggs and pancakes for a relaxed brunch at the 3-stool breakfast bar before heading to the beach. After a day of fun, kick back on the living area’s sofa and armchairs to unwind while watching TV. French doors lead out to a charming balcony, where guests can sip a glass of wine while enjoying the sunset. When it’s time to retire, choose from the guest bedroom with a king bed and attached bathroom or the queen sleeper sofa in the living space.Experience a delightful Seagrove Beach vacation with quick beach access—only 4 minutes away—at Beach Please Carriage House. Effortlessly explore the neighboring towns of Scenic 30A with parking for 1 vehicle in the driveway and 2 complimentary adult bikes. Eastern Lake Beach Access is a quick 4-minute walk down Eastern Lake Road. Book this carriage home for a sunny escape today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 4):SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa**Please note the main house is rented separately and does not include the use of the private pool or Low-Speed Vehicle.
